description: A PHP class defining a custom Twig environment for Drupal, including cache management, template compilation, and metadata handling.

classes.name: TwigEnvironment
classes.description: Custom Twig environment class for Drupal, managing cache, template compilation, and metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TwigEnvironment with cache, loader, and sandbox extension.

methods.name: compileSource
methods.description: Compiles a source with front matter parsing and error handling.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates all cached Twig templates and resets metadata.

methods.name: getTwigCachePrefix
methods.description: Returns the cache prefix used for Twig PHP storage cache.

methods.name: getTemplateMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata associated with a template, parsing front matter.

methods.name: getTemplateClass
methods.description: Returns the class name for a given template, with caching.

methods.name: renderInline
methods.description: Renders a Twig string directly with provided context.
